findings.description: Georg Gajdosch had a daughter Anna, baptised 22 April 1718 at Lidečko, Vsetín, Moravia.
supporting_sources: Czech Republic, Births and Baptisms, 1637-1889 — entry for Anna Gajdosch, 1718, parents Georg Gajdosch and Catharina

findings.description: The mother of the 1718 daughter Anna is named Catharina, not the Dorothea the tree records as Georg Gajdosch's wife.

person.name: Catharina
person.role: wife of Georg Gajdosch, named as mother on the 1718 Lidečko baptism

supporting_sources: Czech Republic, Births and Baptisms, 1637-1889 — entry for Anna Gajdosch, 1718
